comparison.objective: Candidate recovers ceramic media while retaining metal washers; pr-1151 purges air from a filled syringe while preserving the drawn-up liquid.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual screen manipulation and many-body granular-flow control; pr-1151 requires syringe orientation, fine plunger force/displacement control, air-liquid interface management, and rack placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill/contamination/damage, and released dwell; pr-1151 grades residual air and liquid loss together with syringe pose, speed, release, and continuous hold.
comparison.reason: All 21 specifications were available; both penalize material loss, but one tests aperture separation of free rigid bodies and the other precise fluid-preserving syringe purging, with no comparison-critical rubric detail missing.
